title: 有
teacherNotes: Approved L008 lesson. Use only characters learned in L001-L007 plus 有. Focus on simple existence and possession patterns that reuse 我, 人, 手, 大, 小, 的, 個, 一, 二, 三. Reviewed sentences: 有一個人 / 我有小小的手 / 大人有大大的手 / 三個人有大手小手 / 有一大二小的手. The second sentence must use the fixed L007 girl for 我. The fifth sentence should show one big hand and two small hands without full people.
